svg.title: One token on 20 workers, context 1
svg.text: One launch, 1,852 tile tasks in 99 waves; each row is a worker (one thread block per SM), time runs right
Layer 8, 600 µs; each wave with its streamed bytes per task
Where the token's time goes: traced 12.13 ms = ideal streaming 11.61 ms + 518 µs
Ideal streaming: the token's weight and K/V bytes at the measured 213 GB/s; the bar splits the 518 µs above it.
